types.name: AdminUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when the admin authority is updated.

fields.name: admin
docs: The admin that performed the update.

fields.name: old_admin
docs: The previous admin wallet.

fields.name: new_admin
docs: The new admin wallet.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of the update.

types.name: BuyParams
docs: Parameters for a buy instruction.

fields.name: payment_amount
docs: Amount of USDC/USDT to spend (in smallest units).

types.name: BuyerProfile
docs: Per-wallet profile that aggregates activity across all rounds.
One PDA per wallet, created on the first purchase.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The wallet address of the buyer.

fields.name: total_purchased
docs: Total GAIA tokens purchased across all rounds.

fields.name: total_claimed
docs: Total GAIA tokens claimed across all rounds.

fields.name: total_paid
docs: Total USD value paid across all purchases (in micro-USD).

fields.name: purchase_count
docs: Number of individual Purchase PDAs owned by this wallet.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this profile was created.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for this buyer profile.

types.name: BuyerVerifiedEvent
docs: Emitted when a buyer is verified for whitelist access.

fields.name: authority
docs: The compliance authority that verified the buyer.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The wallet that was verified.

fields.name: round_id
docs: The round ID (255 = all rounds).

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of the verification.

types.name: ClaimEvent
docs: Emitted when a user claims vested GAIA tokens.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The wallet claiming tokens.

fields.name: round_id
docs: The round identifier.

fields.name: purchase_number
docs: The purchase number being claimed against.

fields.name: claimed_amount
docs: The amount of GAIA tokens claimed in this transaction.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of the claim.

types.name: Config
docs: Global protocol configuration. Singleton account — one per program deployment.
Stores admin authority, supported mints, vesting TGE reference,
aggregate counters, and pause state.

fields.name: admin
docs: The admin pubkey authorized to manage rounds and protocol settings.

fields.name: treasury
docs: The treasury wallet that receives USDC/USDT payments directly.

fields.name: gaia_mint
docs: The GAIA token mint address.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The accepted USDC mint address.

fields.name: usdt_mint
docs: The accepted USDT mint address.

fields.name: tge_timestamp
docs: Token Generation Event timestamp. All vesting schedules are relative to this.

fields.name: current_round
docs: The current active round identifier.

fields.name: total_tokens_sold
docs: Cumulative GAIA tokens sold across all rounds.

fields.name: total_usdc_raised
docs: Cumulative USDC raised across all rounds (in smallest units).

fields.name: total_usdt_raised
docs: Cumulative USDT raised across all rounds (in smallest units).

fields.name: paused
docs: Whether the entire presale is paused.

fields.name: gaia_vault
docs: The GAIA vault PDA that holds tokens for claim distribution.

fields.name: legal_authority
docs: The legal authority wallet that can clear purchases to begin.

fields.name: legal_cleared
docs: Whether legal clearance has been granted. Required before any purchase.

fields.name: compliance_authority
docs: The compliance authority wallet that can verify buyers for whitelist.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for the Config account.

fields.name: gaia_vault_bump
docs: PDA bump for the GAIA vault account.

types.name: CreateRoundParams
docs: Parameters for creating a new round.

fields.name: name
docs: Human-readable round name.

fields.name: price_micro_usd
docs: Price per 1 GAIA token in micro-USD.

fields.name: tokens_available
docs: Total GAIA tokens available for sale.

fields.name: start_time
docs: Unix timestamp when the round opens.

fields.name: end_time
docs: Unix timestamp when the round closes.

fields.name: cliff_seconds
docs: Seconds after TGE before claims unlock (cliff).

fields.name: vesting_duration_seconds
docs: Total vesting duration in seconds after cliff.

fields.name: minimum_purchase
docs: Minimum payment amount per transaction (in smallest units).

fields.name: maximum_purchase
docs: Maximum payment amount per transaction (in smallest units).

fields.name: maximum_per_wallet
docs: Maximum total spend per wallet in this round.

fields.name: whitelist_enabled
docs: Whether whitelist verification is required.

fields.name: round_type
docs: Type of round (seed or public).

types.name: LegalClearedEvent
docs: Emitted when legal clearance is granted to begin purchases.

fields.name: legal_authority
docs: The legal authority that granted clearance.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of the clearance.

types.name: PausedEvent
docs: Emitted when a presale round is paused.

fields.name: admin
docs: The admin that paused the round.

fields.name: round_id
docs: The round that was paused (0 = global pause).

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of the pause.

types.name: Purchase
docs: An immutable record of a single token purchase transaction.
One PDA per purchase, seeded by wallet address and sequential purchase number.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The wallet that made this purchase.

fields.name: round_id
docs: The round this purchase belongs to.

fields.name: purchase_number
docs: Sequential purchase number for this wallet (matches BuyerProfile.purchase_count at creation).

fields.name: payment_amount
docs: USDC/USDT amount paid in smallest units.

fields.name: payment_mint
docs: The payment mint used (USDC or USDT pubkey).

fields.name: token_amount
docs: Amount of GAIA tokens purchased.

fields.name: claimed_amount
docs: GAIA tokens already claimed from this purchase.

fields.name: price_micro_usd
docs: Price per token at time of purchase (micro-USD), stored for historical auditing.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of the purchase.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for this purchase account.

types.name: PurchaseEvent
docs: Emitted when a user purchases GAIA tokens in a presale round.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The wallet that made the purchase.

fields.name: round_id
docs: The round identifier.

fields.name: purchase_number
docs: Sequential purchase number for this wallet.

fields.name: payment_mint
docs: The payment mint used (USDC or USDT).

fields.name: payment_amount
docs: The amount of USDC/USDT paid (in smallest units).

fields.name: token_amount
docs: The amount of GAIA tokens purchased.

fields.name: price_micro_usd
docs: The price per token at time of purchase (micro-USD).

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of the purchase.

types.name: ResumeEvent
docs: Emitted when a presale round is resumed.

fields.name: admin
docs: The admin that resumed the round.

fields.name: round_id
docs: The round that was resumed (0 = global resume).

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of the resume.

types.name: Round
docs: Represents a single presale round with its parameters and state.
One PDA per round, seeded by the round `id`.

fields.name: id
docs: Unique round identifier (0–255).

fields.name: name
docs: Human-readable round name.

fields.name: price_micro_usd
docs: Price per 1 GAIA token in micro-USD (1 USD = 1_000_000).

fields.name: tokens_available
docs: Total GAIA tokens available for sale in this round.

fields.name: tokens_sold
docs: GAIA tokens already sold in this round.

fields.name: start_time
docs: Unix timestamp when the round opens for purchases.

fields.name: end_time
docs: Unix timestamp when the round closes.

fields.name: cliff_seconds
docs: Seconds after TGE before claims are allowed (cliff period).

fields.name: vesting_duration_seconds
docs: Total seconds over which tokens vest after the cliff.

fields.name: minimum_purchase
docs: Minimum USDC/USDT payment amount per transaction (in smallest units).

fields.name: maximum_purchase
docs: Maximum USDC/USDT payment amount per single transaction (in smallest units).

fields.name: maximum_per_wallet
docs: Maximum total USDC/USDT a single wallet can spend in this round.

fields.name: whitelist_enabled
docs: Whether whitelist verification is required to participate.

fields.name: round_type
docs: Type of round (seed or public).

fields.name: status
docs: Current lifecycle status of the round.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for this round account.

types.name: RoundActivatedEvent
docs: Emitted when an upcoming round is activated.

fields.name: admin
docs: The admin that activated the round.

fields.name: round_id
docs: The round identifier.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of the activation.

types.name: RoundCreatedEvent
docs: Emitted when a new presale round is created.

fields.name: round_id
docs: The round identifier.

fields.name: name
docs: Human-readable round name.

fields.name: price_micro_usd
docs: Price per token in micro-USD.

fields.name: tokens_available
docs: Total tokens available in this round.

fields.name: start_time
docs: Unix timestamp when the round starts.

fields.name: end_time
docs: Unix timestamp when the round ends.

fields.name: round_type
docs: Type of round (seed or public).

types.name: RoundEndedEvent
docs: Emitted when a round is ended prematurely.

fields.name: round_id
docs: The round identifier.

fields.name: name
docs: Human-readable round name.

fields.name: tokens_sold
docs: Total GAIA tokens sold in this round.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of the end.

types.name: RoundStatus
docs: Lifecycle status of a presale round.

types.name: RoundType
docs: Type of presale round (seed vs public).

types.name: Statistics
docs: Global protocol statistics. Singleton account — one per program deployment.
Aggregated counters to avoid scanning thousands of accounts from the frontend.

fields.name: total_buyers
docs: Total unique wallets that have made at least one purchase.

fields.name: total_transactions
docs: Total number of individual purchase transactions.

fields.name: total_usd_micro
docs: Total USD value raised across all rounds (in micro-USD).

fields.name: seed_sold
docs: Total GAIA tokens sold in seed rounds.

fields.name: public_sold
docs: Total GAIA tokens sold in public rounds.

fields.name: total_volume
docs: Total GAIA tokens sold across all rounds.

fields.name: total_tokens_claimed
docs: Total GAIA tokens claimed by buyers across all rounds.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for the statistics account.

types.name: TreasuryUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when the treasury wallet is updated.

fields.name: admin
docs: The admin that updated the treasury.

fields.name: old_treasury
docs: The previous treasury wallet.

fields.name: new_treasury
docs: The new treasury wallet.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of the update.

types.name: UpdateRoundParams

fields.name: name

fields.name: price_micro_usd

fields.name: tokens_available
docs: New tokens available (optional).

fields.name: start_time
docs: New start time (optional).

fields.name: end_time
docs: New end time (optional).

fields.name: cliff_seconds
docs: New cliff seconds (optional).

fields.name: vesting_duration_seconds
docs: New vesting duration (optional).

fields.name: minimum_purchase
docs: New minimum purchase (optional).

fields.name: maximum_purchase
docs: New maximum purchase (optional).

fields.name: maximum_per_wallet
docs: New maximum per wallet (optional).

fields.name: whitelist_enabled
docs: New whitelist flag (optional).

types.name: WhitelistEntry
docs: Represents a buyer verified for whitelist access in a specific round.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The wallet that was verified.

fields.name: round_id
docs: The round ID this entry applies to (255 = all rounds).

fields.name: authority
docs: The compliance authority that verified this wallet.

fields.name: verified_at
docs: Unix timestamp when the verification was made.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for this whitelist entry.

types.name: WithdrawGaiaEvent
docs: Emitted when GAIA tokens are withdrawn from the vault by the admin.

fields.name: admin
docs: The admin that withdrew tokens.

fields.name: amount
docs: The amount of GAIA tokens withdrawn.

fields.name: timestamp
